title: Fan-out (Map-Reduce)

comparison.purpose: A planner generates N subtopics at runtime; the machine spawns one branch per subtopic via XState dynamic spawn (N not known until runtime), each branch is a live child visible in the snapshot, and a reducer composes the summaries into one digest.
